name: Four Seasons Hotel Bahrain Bay
positioning: Luxury tower hotel on its own private island in Manama, with a private beach
best_for: Multi-generational families wanting a city hotel with a beach
Couples and food lovers drawn to Wolfgang Puck dining

facts.text: Opened March 2015 with 273 rooms: 216 guest rooms and 57 suites.
The tower rises 68 storeys from its own manmade 5-hectare (12-acre) island in Manama, reached by a causeway.
Architects were Skidmore, Owings & Merrill; interiors are by Pierre-Yves Rochon, inspired by luxury sea voyages, with a curated collection of Bahraini art.
The hotel is about 15 minutes from Bahrain International Airport.

Dining includes CUT by Wolfgang Puck (steakhouse), re Asian Cuisine by Wolfgang Puck (modern Asian, on the 50th floor), the Bahrain Bay Kitchen international buffet, and poolside Azure (snacks and shisha). Byblos is a beachfront Lebanese restaurant.

The 160-metre (525-foot) white sand beach and a 956 sq. m. outdoor infinity pool are among the hotel's pools and beach facilities, which also include the Azure pool, a kids' pool and an indoor spa pool.
The spa covers 3,485 sq. m. (37,512 sq. ft.) with 17 treatment rooms, designed by Pierre-Yves Rochon, plus separate unisex and women's-only facilities.
Guest rooms and suites are described as having views of the Arabian Gulf or the Manama skyline.

highlights.text: The hotel describes itself as a multi-generational playground with a private white-sand beach, a waterpark for kids, a beach club with games, and adults-only and family pool options.
Wolfgang Puck's CUT and re Asian Cuisine are on site, with the re Asian Cuisine restaurant and Blue Moon Lounge on the 50th floor.
Kayaking, paddle-boarding and poolside cabanas are available, and the hotel runs a fully supervised children's program.
The hotel offers guided Bahrain city tours that visit sites such as Bab Al Bahrain (the old Manama Souq), Qal'at al-Bahrain (a UNESCO World Heritage site) and the Bahrain National Museum.

considerations.text: The hotel sits on a private island reached by causeway, in a modern district rather than the historic areas. Historic sites such as the old souq and the fort are a separate outing, for example on the hotel's guided city tour.
Part of the pool offering is adults-only, so families use the family and kids' pools.
